maria-support: Heads-up — Nimbus is hitting sustained 429s and 1s+ tail latency during yesterday's email campaign. Dedicated pool id dp-47. Baseline QPS ~120, peak bursts up to ~1.2k for ~15-25m windows. They're on dedicated (4x GPU equiv), current min_replicas=2, max_replicas=8. They also reported a handful of auth/billing errors during spikes. Marking urgent, please advise. @jake-se

jake-se: Thanks — can you confirm model, avg sequence length, region/AZ, and the exact errors? Also what's their expected utilization target (e.g., 70%)? Will help with quick sizing math. Can you paste autoscaler logs for the spike window?

maria-support: Model: redwood-7B-q4, avg seq len ~80 tokens, avg request payload ~1.2KB. Region: us-west-2 (multi-AZ). Error pattern: mostly 429s + intermittent 401 seen during retries (billing auth webhook timed out). 99p latency ~1000ms during burst. Autoscaler logs from campaign window:

```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z autoscaler: evaluate pool dp-47 desired=6 current=2 reason="qps>scale_up_threshold"
2026-03-15T14:12:35Z autoscaler: action=scale_up target=4 status=initiated
2026-03-15T14:14:00Z autoscaler: action=scale_up target=6 status=failed error="no capacity in AZ"
2026-03-15T14:20:10Z autoscaler: evaluate pool dp-47 desired=6 current=2 reason="cooldown, awaiting nodes"
2026-03-15T14:25:00Z autoscaler: scale_back target=2 status=completed
```

sre-jen: Looking at infra traces — two things jumped out: (1) AZ-level capacity constraint: scale_up requests failed with "no capacity in AZ" as noted. (2) Noisy-neighbor effect: one replica showed sustained GPU util >95% while others were 30-40% during burst, indicating uneven request distribution / warmup. Also the per-replica rate limiter triggered at ~500rps. Short perf trace snippet: `kv_cache.miss_rate=0.38, avg_infer_ms=52, gpu_util=[96,35,32]`.

infra-bot: ALERT — pool dp-47 429 rate=18% over 15m window. Incident created: INC-2026-134.

ops-eli: Quick mitigation proposal: set min_replicas=4 for scheduled campaign windows and enable burst_capacity=true (allow temporary >max replicas if cloud quota permits). Also increase routing headroom to 1.8x during campaign and pre-warm KV caches. Repro steps to validate locally: `ab -n 10000 -c 200 -p payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` (use warmup payload set).

jake-se: Sizing calc from observed metrics and our per-GPU benchmarks: measured per-GPU sustainable capacity for redwood-7B-q4 at ~70% util ~= 250 QPS. Using that: baseline 120 QPS -> 1 GPU (but keep min 2 for redundancy). Peak 1.2k QPS -> 1200 / 250 = 4.8 -> 5 GPUs. Add headroom for uneven distribution + noisy neighbor + AZ failures -> +40% => 7 replicas. Recommended config for next campaign: min_replicas=3 (avoid single point), desired target=7 during campaign windows, max_replicas=10 (allow safety), enable burst_capacity. Also enable sticky routing to spread KV hotness and run a warmup job 10-15m before expected bursts.

maria-support: Customer wants a utilization goal ~65% and is okay with small cost bump for reliability. I'll propose the recommended plan (min=3, campaign target=7, max=10, burst enabled, KV warmup) and request capacity-team to reserve AZ quota for campaign. Assigning INC-2026-134 to infra-capacity for provisioning and follow-up.

jake-se: Sounds good — also add a short post-mortem checklist: (1) verify autoscaler retries surface better error (AZ capacity) to SRE, (2) add metric for per-replica GPU skews, (3) test warmup script in staging.

ops-eli: I'll pilot the warmup script and a routing tweak this afternoon. Will report perf numbers once done.

maria-support: Thanks all — I'll update Nimbus and schedule a 30m alignment with capacity team. INC-2026-134 will track progress. :thumbsup:
